rationale: Independent reading: held EO 10656 (21 FR 859) establishes the President's Board of Consultants on Foreign Intelligence Activities (secs. 1-5); no own term, no savings clause. Held EO 10938 (26 FR 3951, signed May 4, 1961) sec. 4: 'Executive Order No. 10656 of February 6, 1956, is hereby revoked.' Express whole-order revocation, not a successor-body inference. Refutation attempts: right instrument and quote; no exception. D6: corpus search finds EO 10656 named only in EO 10938 and its neighbouring-page extract EO 10939 (other hits are FR page numbers); EO 11460 sec. 6 later revokes EO 10938 without reviving 10656 (verified). No later event ignored. NO upheld. D6 answer: no later event ignored.
